name: Youth Volunteers Program
what_you_do: Earn service hours at a free science museum. You help guests in the galleries and IMAX theater, greet visitors, or help in the gift store.
who_can_apply: High school juniors and seniors who are 16 or 17.
pay_detail: Unpaid. You earn community service hours.
duration: One 4-hour shift a week, usually on the weekend, for 14 weeks (50 or more hours)
deadline_text: Spring 2027 applications open Nov 1, 2026. All Fall 2026 youth spots are full. No closing date is posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Youth Volunteer Application on the volunteer page. Send the PDF by email to VolunteerDept@californiasciencecenter.org or mail it to the Department of Volunteer Resources, 700 Exposition Park Drive, Los Angeles, CA 90037.
notes: Spots are limited. The same page lists other volunteer roles open at 16 (greeter, floor programs, gift store, office help) that ask for 4 hours a week for 6 months on the adult application. Volunteer Office: 213-744-2124.
